name: Yamaha V Star 1300
engine: 1304 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Yamaha's liquid-cooled Star cruiser. Some 2007 bikes are in a fuel pipe recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2007 V Star 1300s are in recall 11V533 because the fuel delivery pipe may leak.
A-002.reason: A fuel leak near a hot engine is a fire risk. The fix is free.

recalls.what: The fuel delivery pipe may not seal and can leak fuel.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel delivery pipe free.
